from report import summarize

def test_summarize_basic():
    """Test basic counting by status."""
    jobs = [

    """Test case insensitive matching."""
    jobs = [
        {"status": "New"},
        {"status": "NEW"},
        {"status": "nEw"},
    ]
    result = summarize(jobs)
    assert result == {"new": 3, "applied": 0, "rejected": 0, "other": 0}

    """Test stripping surrounding spaces."""
    jobs = [
